assertions.assertion: Calls AddLocalApiAuthentication() to set up local API authentication
assertions.rationale: builder.Services.AddLocalApiAuthentication() is called in the IdentityServer host.
The endpoint uses .RequireAuthorization(IdentityServerConstants.LocalApi.PolicyName) and mentions the controller [Authorize(Policy = ...)] equivalent.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that clients must include 'IdentityServerApi' in their AllowedScopes
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states the policy requires the IdentityServerApi scope and shows a Client with AllowedScopes = { "openid", "profile", "IdentityServerApi" }.

assertions.assertion: Warns that local API authentication only works when the API is co-hosted with IdentityServer, not for separate API hosts
assertions.rationale: An 'Important limitation' section states it only works co-hosted and to use JWT bearer or introspection for separate hosts.
